top_signals.title: Saudis Oil Logistics Roiled Again by Houthis’ Red Sea Threat
top_signals.summary: Saudi Arabia is yet again being forced to overhaul how its oil gets to customers around the world as Yemen’s Houthis make it harder for Riyadh to use a backup route that’s been vital to the global economy since the Iran war started.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: The US Navy has battled operational tempo ordeals for years. The Iran war exposed the flaws.
top_signals.summary: Carrier availability and decisions made during the Iran war have exacerbated the US Navy's longstanding struggles with a frenzied operational tempo.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Decrepit Port Infrastructure has Vessels Stacked Off Venezuela
top_signals.summary: Venezuela's dilapidated oil port terminals are imposing a de facto export cap on the country's resurgent crude production, with tankers having to wait up to 30 days to load because of ageing infrastructure, power outages and quality issues, according to shipping data…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 400 Security Holes
top_signals.summary: Microsoft today released updates to remedy at least 398 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and supported software, including one weakness that is already being actively exploited and two others that were publicly detailed prior to today.

top_signals.title: Lessons Learned from CISA’s Recent GitHub Leak
top_signals.summary: The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has issued a postmortem on a data leak in which a contractor published dozens of internal CISA credentials -- including AWS Govcloud keys -- in a public GitHub repository for almost six months before being notified by KrebsOnSecurity. Experts say the gaps identified in the agency's initial response provide important lessons that all security teams should absorb.
